idp.title: Identity Providers
idp.subtitle: SAML 2.0 single sign-on for your organization.

enterprise.title: SSO is an Enterprise feature
enterprise.body: Connect a SAML 2.0 identity provider (Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace…) so your team signs in with your IdP. Single sign-on is available on the Enterprise edition.

empty.title: No identity providers configured
empty.body: Add a SAML 2.0 provider to let your team sign in with your corporate IdP.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Unique. Used in the SSO URL.
form.providerTypeHint: A label, e.g. azure, okta, google.
form.privateKeyHintEdit: Leave empty to keep the stored key.
form.privateKeyHintCreate: Required. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
form.issuerHint: Discovery runs against this; the provider must serve /.well-known/openid-configuration under it.
form.redirectUrlHint: Register this exact URL with the provider.
form.bindDnHint: A service account that may search the directory.
form.userFilterHint: Must contain %s, where the address typed at login is placed.
form.provisioningHint: What happens when someone the directory vouches for signs in.
form.jit: Create the account on first sign-in
form.defaultRoleHint: Given when no group matches. Without one, an unmatched sign-in is refused.
form.groupsAttributeHint: Where the provider puts group membership.
form.syncRolesHint: Roles not in the mapping are removed, so a change in the directory reaches here. Without this, a demotion never arrives.
form.mappingsHint: A directory group on the left, the role it grants on the right.
form.noMappings: No mappings. Everyone gets the default role.
form.secretHintCreate: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.secretHintEdit: Leave blank to keep the stored one.

errors.url: Must be a valid http(s) URL.
errors.httpsUrl: Must be a valid https URL.
errors.hostname: Enter a host or IP without a scheme (e.g. ldap.example.com).
errors.port: Port must be a whole number between 0 and 65535.
errors.pemCertificate: Does not look like a PEM certificate (missing -----BEGIN/END CERTIFICATE-----).
errors.pemKey: Does not look like a PEM private key (missing -----BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY-----).
errors.userFilterPlaceholder: The filter must contain %s, where the login address is placed.
errors.userFilterUnbalanced: Parentheses are unbalanced — the search will return nothing.
errors.nameFormat: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores (max 64). It appears in the SSO URL, so no spaces.
errors.redirectUrl: Must be a valid https URL, or an http loopback URL (localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1]).
errors.entityId: Must be a valid URI, e.g. https://utmstack.example.com/sp.

delete.title: Delete identity provider
delete.body: Delete {{name}}? Users will no longer be able to sign in through it. This cannot be undone.

toast.paidPlan: SAML SSO requires a paid plan
